closure_law.implementation_before_gate: ForgeOS may implement and test only its client, adapter, orchestration, and presentation side against explicit fixtures before the Nyx gate is satisfied.
closure_law.minimum_state_meaning: Every listed Nyx skill must be BANKED or RELEASE_EARNED in the Nyx append-only ledger. A prose claim, source presence, green compile, locally proved state, or copied fixture is insufficient.
closure_law.minimum_proof_meaning: The Nyx proof receipt must meet or exceed the listed proof level and exercise the real server/engine path required by the Forge closure witness.
closure_law.status_resolution: Never copy Nyx status into ForgeOS as authority. Resolve current state from the supplied Nyx ledger/router projection at the time of Forge closure.
closure_law.separate_patch_rule: A blocker owned by Nyx produces a separate Nyx_Server patch. A blocker owned by ForgeOS produces a separate Forge_OS_V1 patch. Never fix both by placing Nyx implementation in ForgeOS.

dependencies.forge_owns: Configured Unix/TCP client transport, handshake request framing, response decoding, compatibility classification, and typed ForgeOS-side probe results.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The real health endpoint, public contract-version posture, capability discovery, canonical schemas, and truthful readiness data.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: No health server, capability registry, protocol-version authority, model call, or Nyx runtime may be implemented inside ForgeOS.
dependencies.closure_witness: A real Nyx process answers the ForgeOS probe; fixtures may prove client behavior but cannot close the skill by themselves.

dependencies.forge_owns: Typed display and transport of grants, checkpoint identities, decisions, expirations, and resume tokens.
dependencies.nyx_owns: Checkpoint creation, approval binding, accepted-operation identity, duplicate-approval prevention, and immutable request semantics.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not mint Nyx checkpoints, reinterpret approval scope, regenerate a gated action, or maintain a second permission engine.
dependencies.closure_witness: ForgeOS round-trips an exact Nyx-issued checkpoint and proves mutation, expiry, denial, or duplicate approval cannot authorize a different operation.

dependencies.forge_owns: Launching, supervising, restarting, and stopping the external Nyx service process as part of a ForgeOS session.
dependencies.nyx_owns: Its executable server path and truthful bounded health response.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may supervise Nyx but may not embed, fork, or recreate the Nyx server/runtime inside forge-session or forge-nyx-client.
dependencies.closure_witness: The managed external Nyx process becomes healthy, is detected unhealthy after failure, restarts under policy, and stops cleanly.

dependencies.forge_owns: Model/session selection UI state, client streaming consumption, reconnect behavior, and typed error presentation.
dependencies.nyx_owns: Model catalog truth, route selection, governed chat execution, streaming events, server-owned sessions/threads, and persisted conversation identity.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not call local model runtimes directly, own the model registry, store canonical Nyx conversation state, or synthesize stream events.
dependencies.closure_witness: ForgeOS lists Nyx-provided models, selects one, streams a real response, reconnects to the same server-owned conversation, and preserves model attribution.

dependencies.forge_owns: Supplying the active ForgeOS project contract and presenting recorded tool calls/results.
dependencies.nyx_owns: Sandboxed repository reads, safe-read tool descriptors and dispatch, source provenance, Git-status metadata consumption, and audit records.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: forge-nyx-client may not read repository files on Nyx behalf, fabricate tool results, bypass Nyx policy, or become a second Repo/Tool engine.
dependencies.closure_witness: Nyx uses its own governed read tools against the ForgeOS-declared project and returns source-linked evidence that ForgeOS can independently compare to the repository.

dependencies.forge_owns: Declaring ForgeOS registered commands, presenting the exact pending action, transporting decisions, and showing execution records.
dependencies.nyx_owns: Tool request generation, checkpoint pause, exact one-time resume, durable pending-operation identity, denial, expiry, and no-duplicate-effects behavior.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not rerun Nyx planning after approval, replace argv/path/scope, silently execute an equivalent command, or maintain a hidden pending-action queue.
dependencies.closure_witness: Approve, deny, expire, and restart paths operate on the identical Nyx pending operation and produce no duplicate or substituted effects.

dependencies.forge_owns: The user-facing project-selection context, chat surface, citations display, and independent comparison controls.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The governed local-model run, repeated safe-read loop, repository answer, exact snippets/hashes, selection rationale, and complete run record.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not precompute the answer, inject hidden source context, imitate citations, or execute a second agent loop.
dependencies.closure_witness: A user asks about real source through ForgeOS and verifies Nyx-cited files, snippets, and run evidence against the active repository.

dependencies.forge_owns: Approval/denial controls, exact pending-action rendering, and user-visible audit navigation.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The suspended run, immutable action identity, one-time continuation, durable checkpoint, and complete reconstructable run evidence.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not mutate the pending action, fabricate a resume, regenerate the command, or claim an approval occurred without Nyx evidence.
dependencies.closure_witness: A user approves, denies, expires, and restarts a real gated run while ForgeOS resolves every visible claim to Nyx-owned evidence.

dependencies.forge_owns: Integrated service supervision, client/UI orchestration, project binding, user controls, and truthful presentation of Nyx-owned state.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The complete governed agent path, durable/restartable run identity, local runtime lifecycle, sessions, tools, policy, checkpoints, and evidence.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: No model host, conversation store, tool router, policy engine, checkpoint engine, run recorder, or local-agent runtime may be duplicated in ForgeOS.
dependencies.closure_witness: The full local journey runs against a real managed Nyx process, survives restart, preserves project/session identity, and keeps denied authority denied.

dependencies.forge_owns: The ForgeOS task envelope fields for repository, revision, worktree, allowed paths, required commands, and user-visible budget controls.
dependencies.nyx_owns: Versioned agent request/response contracts, bounded run semantics, model/tool/token/time budgets, route cost evidence, and durable run records.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not invent terminal agent status, calculate provider truth from prose, or keep a competing canonical agent run record.
dependencies.closure_witness: ForgeOS can round-trip complete, failed, cancelled, and budget-exhausted Nyx records while repository/worktree fields remain Forge-owned.

dependencies.forge_owns: Creating the isolated Git worktree, binding exact source revision/scope, presenting provider/model/budget choices, and transporting the task.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The governed repository task, cancellation semantics, explicitly allowlisted remote route, privacy/network/cost policy, and run evidence.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not contact the remote model provider around Nyx, run its own coding-agent loop, or let Nyx mutate the authoritative worktree directly.
dependencies.closure_witness: A real remote Nyx route executes or cancels one scoped task against an isolated ForgeOS-created worktree with complete policy, route, cost, and run evidence.

dependencies.forge_owns: The bounded-task review screen, worktree isolation, exact source scope, dispatch confirmation, and returned-artifact intake.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The remote governed task, cancellation, route evidence, and inert patch proposal that never applies itself.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not fake agent progress or results; Nyx may not bypass the ForgeOS worktree/scope contract or apply its proposal.
dependencies.closure_witness: A user dispatches one real bounded task and confirms Nyx returned an inert, attributable result while the primary worktree remained unchanged.

dependencies.forge_owns: Source/worktree isolation, patch review/application, local validation, commit flow, and the final user approval boundary.
dependencies.nyx_owns: The complete governed remote agent path, durable/cancellable run, allowlisted remote route, inert patch proposal, and hash-bound approval posture.
dependencies.forbidden_forge_implementation: ForgeOS may not become a second remote-agent runtime; Nyx may not auto-apply, alter the primary worktree, award Forge closure, or treat provider output as local proof.
dependencies.closure_witness: The complete real task returns an inert patch, ForgeOS reviews and validates it locally, and no mutation occurs before explicit ForgeOS-side approval.

forge_only_consumers.rule: No new direct Nyx skill gate. It consumes the returned artifact from FORGEOS-V1-AGENT-200 and owns hash/base validation, diff review, rejection, and controlled ForgeOS-side application.
No new direct Nyx skill gate. It owns ForgeOS-side review and application after the upstream Nyx-gated agent result exists.

current_seam_findings.forge_behavior: Private binary request/response magic FGNYXQ/FGNYXR over configured Unix or TCP transport.
current_seam_findings.nyx_behavior: HTTP/JSON server routes including GET /v1/nyx/health; the current health response contains status, version, and boot_ts.
current_seam_findings.negative_evidence: Nyx_Server contains no FGNYXQ or FGNYXR handler or canonical contract.
current_seam_findings.closure_effect: FORGEOS-V1-NYX-100 cannot close from its current Forge-only fixtures or wire format.
allowed_resolution: Preferred: ForgeOS consumes a canonical versioned Nyx HTTP/JSON health and capability-discovery contract once the required Nyx API skills are banked.
Alternative: Nyx_Server defines and implements an explicit versioned binary handshake under Nyx API authority, then ForgeOS consumes that published contract.
current_seam_findings.forbidden_resolution: Do not implement a handshake server, capability registry, or Nyx runtime inside ForgeOS merely to satisfy the Forge client tests.
